name: eMACS J0841.8-0429 (Hubble)
blurb: eMACS J0841.8-0429, a massive galaxy cluster, seen by Hubble.
label: emacsj084180429-hubble
story: A distant crowd of galaxies bound by gravity, found by its X-ray glow and imaged by Hubble in a hunt for the universe's most powerful natural lenses.

claims.text: eMACS J0841.8-0429 is a galaxy cluster in the eMACS sample, with HST imaging in F606W, F814W, F110W, F140W
eMACS (extended Massive Cluster Survey) is an X-ray selected survey for very massive distant clusters
HST program 15843 snapshots the most X-ray luminous distant clusters to find the strongest gravitational lenses; eMACSJ0841.8-0429 is a target
